verdict.rationale: Claude documents a user-controlled Model Improvement setting in its privacy settings, which governs whether chats and coding sessions are used to improve Claude. Incognito chats are excluded from model improvement regardless of that setting. This is an opt-out over data use rather than an explicit telemetry or analytics opt-out, so it covers only part of the story. Missing for 10: an explicit telemetry/usage-analytics opt-out control, documentation of what tracking is disabled across apps and Claude Code, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
